data.body_html:
Feria San Bernabe 2034 is Marbella's biggest summer party — and there's no better way to kick it off than from the deck of a private yacht. Imagine cruising the Costa del Sol with your friends, champagne in hand, as the sun sets over La Concha. Then, dock at Puerto Banús and head straight to the fairground for flamenco, casetas, and rides. This guide shows you exactly how to plan the ultimate feria san bernabe 2034 marbella boat party with our fleet.

Why Combine Feria San Bernabe with a Boat Party?

Feria San Bernabe runs for a week in mid-June, transforming Marbella town centre into a non-stop fiesta. But the real magic happens when you escape the crowds for a few hours on the Mediterranean. A boat party gives you:

  • Private space for your group (up to 12 guests)
  • Unlimited drinks and snacks included in the price
  • Swim stops at Cala del Faro or Cabopino
  • Stunning views of the Marbella coastline and Golden Mile
  • Easy transfer to the fair — just 10 minutes by taxi from Puerto Banús

With our boats departing from Puerto Banús, you can enjoy the best of both worlds: a luxury charter and the authentic local fair.

Our Fleet for Feria San Bernabe 2034

We offer a range of boats to suit groups of 5 to 12 people. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden extras.

How to Plan Your Feria San Bernabe Boat Party

Here's a step-by-step plan to make your 2034 celebration unforgettable:

  • Step 1: Choose your boat — Tier A for budget-friendly luxury, Tier B for a premium experience with jet ski.
  • Step 2: Contact us via WhatsApp with your date and group size. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link.
  • Step 3: Arrive at Puerto Banús 15 minutes before departure. Your skipper will greet you and brief you on safety.
  • Step 4: Cruise along the coast, stop for a swim at Cala Cortés, and enjoy the onboard drinks and snacks.
  • Step 5: Return to Puerto Banús, take a taxi to the fairground (€10-15), and join the Feria San Bernabe festivities.

Early booking is recommended — Feria week is one of the busiest of the year.

What to Expect at Feria San Bernabe 2034

Feria San Bernabe is Marbella's answer to Seville's April Fair, but with a coastal twist. Expect:

  • Over 50 casetas (tented pavilions) with live music, dancing, and food
  • Fairground rides and games for all ages
  • Traditional flamenco shows and horse parades
  • Nightly fireworks over the Mediterranean
  • Local specialities like pescaíto frito and rebujito

The fairground is located at Avenida del Mar, near the old town. Most casetas open from midday until dawn.

Best Boats for a Feria Boat Party

For groups of 10-12, the Mangusta 80 (€4,719/4h) is the ultimate party platform. It comes with a free jet ski, so you can take turns riding the waves. The Azimut 58 Flybridge offers a spacious upper deck for sunbathing and socialising. For smaller groups, the Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39 are cost-effective at €749 for 2 hours — perfect for a pre-feria warm-up.

If you want a more relaxed vibe, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) is ideal for couples or small families. All boats depart from Puerto Banús, so you're never far from the action.

Pricing Overview

We keep pricing transparent. Here's a quick summary:

  • Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39): €749/2h → €2,299/8h
  • Tier B (Mangusta 80, white/grey): €4,719 minimum 4h (jet ski included)
  • Other boats: pricing on request via WhatsApp

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. No surprises.
